requirements.text: Continuous task-after-task operation until the owner returns ('u keep running till in the morning tesk after tesk'): while the owner sleeps the orchestrator keeps completing ledger work one task after another without waiting for owner replies (ADR-006 Tier A; the D-080 overnight precedent) - accept what is ready (M5-T109 first), contract the next released, non-held packets, dispatch producers, run the independent review waves, record gates, accept at seams, and re-feed. The loop-lane share runs as orchestrator-dispatched subagent producers while B-026 keeps the lanes down (the workaround recorded on B-026), several packets at once only when their allowed_paths are pairwise disjoint (D-087-R002, D-088-R005), up to D-088-R001's five, reduced stepwise for machine contention (D-088-R006 disk space).
requirements.required_harness: The normal contract -> claim -> gate -> accept lifecycle per task; a recorded pairwise-disjointness check before each parallel dispatch wave.
requirements.required_evidence: The overnight ledger delta (accepted tasks, gate records, seam commits) and the morning handoff.

requirements.text: 'Keep running' lifts NO stop condition: Tier D / Section 20 hard stops; owner holds (expansion section 2 minus the D-040/D-076/D-082/D-087 scoped releases; PR #241 never merged; the unmounted max-envelope route; native DWG licensing); gate FAIL handling (rework, never override); genuine blockers; dependency security with no agent waiver; the thin-client limits; and the D-064/D-085 model pins (never pass model: on a dispatch) all stand. The OWNER-TYPED loop commissioning and canary approval (B-026; runbook section 12; D-088 scope) are never run on the owner's behalf.
requirements.required_harness: Every overnight action stays inside Tier A/B; any Tier D or owner-typed item is queued for the morning, never executed.
requirements.required_evidence: Absence of any hold/gate/Tier D change or commissioning run in the overnight commits and logs.

requirements.text: Owner-needed items wait for the morning: the owner is asleep, so no owner-typed step (the B-026 commissioning, the canary digest approval, any Tier D or legal answer) can happen overnight. Each such item is queued for the morning report and the next accepted dependency continues (ADR-006 Tier C); nothing blocks on an owner reply.
requirements.required_harness: Owner-needed items recorded (blocker, backlog or handoff) while work continues on independent packets.

requirements.text: Morning report in simple English (D-064; D-088-R007): what was finished overnight, what waits for the owner (the loop commissioning commands filled in and ready to paste; any owner decisions), and why the loops did not run overnight (the commissioning is owner-typed).
requirements.required_harness: An owner-facing reply in plain words with the exact lines to type.
requirements.required_evidence: The morning session reply + the handoff.
